SELECT t.transaction_id, t.transaction_type, t.merchant_name, t.amount, t.balance_after, t.transacted_at, ec.expense_category_id AS category_id, ec.category_name FROM `transaction` t LEFT JOIN expense_category ec ON t.expense_category_id = ec.expense_category_id
ORDER BY t.transacted_at DESC, t.transaction_id DESC LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}

SELECT transacted_at FROM `transaction` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND (merchant_name LIKE '%급여%' OR merchant_name LIKE '%월급%' OR merchant_name LIKE '%수당%') AND transacted_at <= NOW() ORDER BY transacted_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT account_id FROM `transaction` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND (merchant_name LIKE '%급여%' OR merchant_name LIKE '%월급%' OR merchant_name LIKE '%수당%') AND transacted_at <= NOW() ORDER BY transacted_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN ec.expense_type = 'FIXED' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS fixedExpense,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN ec.expense_type = 'VARIABLE' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS variableExpense
FROM transaction t JOIN expense_category ec ON t.expense_category_id = ec.expense_category_id
WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.transaction_type IN ('WITHDRAWAL', 'PAYMENT') AND t.transacted_at >= #{startDateTime} AND t.transacted_at < #{endDateTime}

SELECT ec.expense_category_id AS categoryId, ec.category_name AS categoryName,
COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN t.amount WHEN t.transaction_type = 'REFUND' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS amount FROM `transaction` t JOIN expense_category ec ON t.expense_category_id = ec.expense_category_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.transacted_at >= #{startDate} AND t.transacted_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND t.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND ec.expense_type = 'VARIABLE' GROUP BY ec.expense_category_id, ec.category_name ORDER BY amount DESC
